EC1: 1. Lacks English-speaking ability as determined by self-report and clinical evaluation.
EC2: 2. Evidence of schizophrenia, [OR] schizoaffective disorder, [OR] psychosis, [OR] bipolar I and II disorder.
EC3: 3. Active suicidal ideation, intent, [OR] or plan, [OR] or past attempt within 1 year.
EC5: 5. Neurological disorder (epilepsy, [OR] multiple sclerosis, [OR] traumatic brain injury, clinical stroke).
EC6: 6. Use of medications known to have negative impact on cognition (benzodiazepines [OR] and lorazepam equivalents > 1mg daily, narcotics, [OR] anticholinergics).
EC7: 7. History of alcohol [OR] or drug abuse [OR] or dependence within past year.
EC8: 8. Acute, severe, unstable medical illness. For cancer, acutely ill patients (including those with metastases) are [NOT] excluded, but past history of successfully treated cancer does [NOT] not result in [NOT] exclusion.
EC9: 9. Regular online brain training [OR] or regular player of [NOT] non-fluency verbal games, defined as doing these procedures at a frequency of twice weekly or greater during the year prior to screening.
